create_gptoss_model: create a GptOssForCausalLM model with config and quantization config for inference
build_gptoss_decoder_layer: build a GptOssDecoderLayer with attention, MoE MLP, and layer normalization for transformer inference
run_gptoss_forward: run a forward pass on GptOssForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and forward batch info
load_gptoss_weights: load weights into GptOssForCausalLM from HuggingFace safetensors with MXFP4 quantization support
test_gptoss_attention: test GptOssAttention with sliding window, rope embeddings, and tensor parallel KV head partitioning
